children.value: > Fact From Story: In a TikTok posted by Francesca on Thursday 5 October, the father-daughter duo appeared on camera while the legendary director’s daughter explained that she was going to quiz him on popular internet slang.
> > Fact From Story: “I’m going to ask you to guess what specific slang terms mean,” Francesca told her father, 80.
> > > Fact From Story: Martin Scorsese chimed in, in classic style.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: It is normal to appear on camera in a TikTok video.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Asking someone to guess something is a quiz.
> Commonsense Knowledge: TikTok is a venue for posting videos.
